text:
maya: Hey sec team — I have a small PR to change how tenant-proxy reads tenant credentials. Need a quick security/privacy check and an LGTM if nothing major. Planning to merge today around 16:00 PT to unblock a rollout. PR: https://git.redwood.dev/r/tenant-proxy/pulls/482

ram: pinged. Can you summarize what actually changed? diff is a bit noisy.

maya: sure — short summary:
- stop passing raw tenant secret via ENV in the deploy YAML
- use projected secret mount (Kubernetes projected secret) + token refresh helper
- add a sanitized logging wrapper to prevent accidental creds in logs

zane: FYI this will touch the VPC egress rule for the proxy instances — PR mentions a new external call to auth.redwood-prod. Make sure infra is OK with 443 egress. I can update firewall if approved.

maya: thanks @zane. We only call KMS endpoint and internal auth service; the external call is a telemetry ping (opt-out enabled). I can remove telemetry in this PR if needed.

ram: few quick asks before LGTM:
1) paste the exact manifest line where env -> volume change happens (I want to confirm no accidental plaintext fallback)
2) confirm KMS key policy unchanged (if you changed keys we need key admin approval)
3) add a unit/integration test that asserts no secret value is present in logs

maya: paste of the manifest snippet:
```
- name: TENANT_SECRET
  valueFrom:
    secretKeyRef:
      name: tenant-creds
      key: secret
---
# replaced with projected mount
volumeMounts:
- name: tenant-creds-projected
  mountPath: /var/run/tenant/creds
  readOnly: true
```
KMS key: same key ARN as before, no policy change.
Added a test: tests/security/test_no_secrets_in_logs.py (basic smoke that searches log lines), and updated CI to run it.

audit-bot: CI check passed: unit tests OK, lint OK, security-scan: SECRET_SCAN (low) - historical key pattern only, no raw credentials detected. (job: ci-tenant-proxy/482)

olivia: privacy note — we need to confirm the telemetry ping is off by default for EU regions. Can you ensure the ping respects tenant region and doesn't include tenant_id in the payload?

maya: yes, telemetry disabled by default; when enabled it sends only anonymized counters (no tenant_id). I'll add a comment and a config flag for region gating.

ram: thanks. One more ask: add an entry to the audit log whenever a projected secret is refreshed (timestamp + service identity). We need that for forensics.

maya: will add audit log emit in the token refresh flow, low overhead. I'll push a tiny commit in ~20m.

ram: once you push that and CI passes, I'm happy to +1. Also please rotate the staging tenant secret after merge (we don't want long-lived creds in staging).

zane: infra ok with egress as long as telemetry off by default; I can schedule firewall change if needed for prod after rollout.

olivia: privacy gives a conditional LGTM — ensure telemetry flag docs + EU gating.

maya: pushed commit that adds audit log and telemetry gating, updated test to catch logging. New commit: 8f3c2d4. CI rerun queued.

audit-bot: CI check passed: all tests (including security smoke) green. (job: ci-tenant-proxy/482 rerun)

ram: LGTM from security. Please file a post-merge ticket to rotate staging creds and add a short runbook for secret refresh handling.

maya: thanks everyone — merging at 16:00 PT after final verification. Will follow up with the runbook and staging rotate ticket. :thumbsup:
